comment: The buffer is DDLY_MAX_DELAY_TIME, defined as 3, times the sample rate, reallocated in onAdd. The time knob is cubed at DDLY.cpp:250 and elsewhere and floored at 0.0004 of the buffer. The write head at DDLY.cpp:355 computes hp - hp_input, which is the negative of the high-passed signal, so the buffer holds an inverted copy; it looks like a sign slip rather than a design choice, and it is described in the lines as what it does rather than as a fault. The clock ratio table is the sixteen values 0.125 to 2.0 at DDLY.cpp:185. The two CV jacks in the left column carry no printed label on the panel; their tooltips are Time CV and Feedback CV. sumRange on the time CV is the clip at DDLY.cpp:151, a normalised 0 to 1 of the buffer rather than a voltage; it is spelled in the only form the field allows.
